title: FarmerThreeQuestionSurvey
description: Standardized schema for farmer-provided agronomic field symptom survey.

root_condition.description: Condition of root system observed during field inspection.

stem_health.description: Health and structural integrity of the plant stem.

recent_chemical_spray.description: Any chemical or fertilizer treatments applied within past 14 days.

crop_growth_stage.description: Current agronomic growth stage of the crop.

notes.description: Optional free-text observations from farmer or field scout.
